item.description:
publications

Self-archived publication material

The scientific journal subscription costs in Finland 2010–2017 data set, maintained by the Finnish Ministry of Education and Culture (Open Science and Research Initiative), was released following my Freedom of Information Request and subsequent appeal in administrative court. With this, Finland became the first country to systematically collect and release public information on scientific journal subscription prices.

miaverse (microbiome.github.io) is a microbiome data science ecosystem built on the Bioconductor SummarizedExperiment family, covering high-throughput analysis, visualization, simulation, time series, interactive exploration, access to the EBI MGnify and HoloFood resources, and open data sharing. The ten Bioconductor packages below form its core. The reproducible online tutorial book Orchestrating Microbiome Analysis (microbiome.github.io/OMA) describes how to take advantage of the ecosystem. In 2021 we provided training on this framework in intensive courses in Oulu, the Netherlands, Barcelona and at CSC, as well as virtually.

My research software projects have been published in CRAN, Bioconductor, Julia and Github, with altogether 100,000+ downloads per year, and include two international data science developer networks that I coordinate and lead, each encompassing multiple software packages (rOpenGov and miaverse). The projects listed below are mature and many of them are associated with peer-reviewed publications, grants and awards. I am the main developer or a major co-developer in all listed cases.
